description: Approve or reject a submission. Approving releases the perk; a rejection may carry a reason, which the customer sees. Use this when the business chooses manual review over auto-verification.

decision.description: Approve releases the perk. Reject explains why the proof was insufficient.

reason.description: Optional. Saved with the decision and shown to the customer in the rejection email. Up to 500 chars.

submissionId.description: Submission id from a prior submitProof call.

name: reviewSubmission
